title: .gitlab-ci.yml pipeline definition served
description: The response is a GitLab CI pipeline definition: a stages list with job blocks. It names the images, the registries and the deploy targets of the pipeline, and often the variables that select them.
remediation: Exclude CI definitions from the deployed tree and deny them at the server level.
limitation: One response body. The rule reads the pipeline structure; it does not run a job.

observation.body:
stages:
  - build
  - deploy

build:
  stage: build
  script:
    - docker build -t registry.internal/shop .

stages:
  - test

test:
  variables:
    DB_HOST: db.internal
  script:
    - pytest -q
Define stages at the top of the file.
